about: Held-out questions for the test of the two levers (retrieval_levers_protocol_2026-10-08.json). Written and committed BEFORE any lever was run. The 30 answerable facts were not picked by the person who wrote the questions: candidate sentences were drawn from each document with a fixed seed (scratchpad sample_lines.py, seed 20261008, per-document shuffle of every 12-45 word sentence that does not already contain a key of retrieval_labels_2026-10-08.json) and a question was written for the first usable candidates in each document's order. Skipped candidates are listed in `skipped`.
